item.title: Spacious 1.0.0
item.description:
First release.

Added

  • Guided cleanup of caches, logs, browser and desktop-app caches, developer caches, Docker, downloads, backups and more, each explained in plain English with a safety level.
  • Code Projects, Large Files, Apps (uninstall with leftovers) and Explore Disk with a treemap.
  • Step-by-step guides for data owned by other apps (Photos, iCloud Drive, WhatsApp, VMs…).
  • Review screen showing every file before anything is removed.
  • "How it comes back" label for every group; only items that rebuild automatically are deleted outright, everything else goes to the Trash.
  • Looks inside cache folders for logins, credentials, databases, git repositories and documents, and leaves those items unticked.
  • Undo: put items back from the Trash from History.
  • Cancel while cleaning; anything already moved to the Trash is put back.
  • Bulk selection with filters, Shift-click ranges and tri-state checkboxes.
  • Protect items so they're never suggested again.
  • Menu-bar gauge with free space, one-click safe cleanup and smart alerts (low space, big Trash, macOS installers, big growth), optionally as notifications. Settings › Monitoring.
  • "What's changing" on the Overview: free space over time and what grew or shrank since about a week ago, from a small daily summary kept on your Mac.
  • Duplicates: byte-for-byte identical files in your personal folders, with what removing each copy really frees (aware of APFS clones), keep rules (Smart / oldest / newest) and a guarantee that one copy always stays.
  • Smarter installer cleanup: knows whether each .dmg/.pkg's app is installed and which version, finds apps left in Downloads and zips you've already extracted.
  • One permission instead of many: without Full Disk Access, Spacious no longer reads folders macOS guards with their own prompts (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, iCloud Drive, Photos, Music, TV, Contacts, Calendars, other apps' data). The welcome screen asks for Full Disk Access first and starts the first scan by itself after the restart; "Continue without it" runs a limited scan.
  • Check for Updates (Spacious menu and Settings › About), with an optional weekly check that's off by default. Spacious goes online only for this. Updates and the feed are signed and verified (Sparkle 2, EdDSA) before anything is installed.
  • Scheduled cleaning (off by default; daily, weekly or every two weeks): only green caches that rebuild themselves and only recommended, unflagged items; logged in History with an optional notification. Settings › Monitoring.
  • Safety snapshot before any cleanup that deletes permanently: permanently deleted items can be recovered from History for about a day (administrator password needed to recover); release it any time. Settings › General.
  • Review & Clean shows everything selected from every screen, with untick and jump-to; the selection bar breaks the selection down by screen and opens Review. Clean Up lists what's ticked on other screens at the bottom.
  • Overview tiles open the matching filtered list and show how much of each is ticked; the sidebar shows ticked vs found per screen; a "Ticked" filter on every list.
  • Quiet background checks (every 6/12/24 hours, measuring only) and Open at Login.
  • Works entirely offline.
